queries: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: 'Using 60.8 GB as the cutoff' for memory-heavy runs means memusagegb strictly greater than 60.8.
The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per run as procgpu/proccpu using real division. Runs with proccpu = 0 give a NULL ratio (via NULLIF) and are ignored. Runs with NULL values are ignored by AVG.
Each site code has one entrystat, so grouping by site code and entrystat gives one row per site. The second step averages these per-site values, so every site has equal weight.

alternatives.interpretation: Memory-heavy runs are those with memusagegb at or above 60.8 GB (inclusive cutoff).

assumptions.assumption: 'Memory-heavy ... using 60.8 GB as the cutoff' means memusagegb strictly greater than 60.8.
Runs with a zero proccpu give a NULL ratio (via NULLIF) rather than an error, and NULL ratios or memory values are ignored in the averages.
The ratio is computed per run (procgpu/proccpu as real, not integer division) and then averaged per site. It is not computed as the ratio of averages.
Sites with a NULL entrystat are grouped together as their own NULL group.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive: runs with memusagegb of at least 60.8 GB count as memory-heavy.

assumptions.assumption: 'Memory-heavy' means memusagegb strictly greater than 60.8; runs at exactly 60.8 are excluded.
The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per run with floating-point division. Runs with proccpu = 0 are treated as missing (NULLIF), and NULL values are ignored by AVG.
Runs are matched to sites with an inner join on zoneref = zoneregistry. Runs with no matching site are dropped, and a site whose entrystat is NULL forms its own NULL group.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive: memory usage of 60.8 GB or more counts as memory-heavy.
